definitions.explanation: The surgeon who performs or leads a surgical operation. Distinguished from assistant surgeons or other members of the surgical team.

examples.japanese: {執刀医|しっとうい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{経験豊富|けいけんほうふ}→経験豊富：19017_keikenhoufu⟧な{執刀医|しっとうい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: An experienced surgeon performed the operation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{執刀医|しっとうい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: The patient's family received an explanation from the lead surgeon before the operation.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{執刀|しっとう}→執刀：19210_shittou⟧ (holding the scalpel; performing surgery) and {医|い} (doctor). Used in medical contexts and news reports about surgeries.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {執刀医|しっとうい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧ (the surgeon performs the operation)
- {執刀医|しっとうい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧ (to serve as the operating surgeon)
